description: When we talk about policies that shape our daily lives, it’s easy to get lost in broad ideas and distant government offices. But the truth is, the best policies start right here, in our own neighborhoods. Prioritizing local community needs in policies is not just a good idea—it’s essential. It ensures that the voices of those who live, work, and raise families in our area are heard and acted upon. This approach leads to stronger schools, better housing, and more support for veterans and families
paid_for_by: paid for by Luther Wilkins,  Democrat,  for Florida State House District 70
title: Prioritizing Local Community Needs in Policies: A Path to Stronger Neighborhoods
